title: fix(scenarios): travel_expense's verified build edits its lines inline again, and each build's provenance names the scorer it passed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu4ADf6K3c79Bin3C2m4JZ5C)_

Fixes #37917

## What changes

- `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`: one field group added to `demotravel_expense_claim.fieldGroups`, between `claim` and `status`: `{ "key": "lines", "label": "Expense Lines", "collapse": "none", "relatedList": "demotravel_claim_line" }`. Nothing else in the build moves; `demotravel_claim_line.claim` keeps `inlineEdit: "grid"` and `inlineTitle`.
- `travel_expense.provenance.json`: `sha256` moved, with an `amended` entry (`from` = the old sha256) saying what changed and why; a new top-level `scored` = `{ "runner": "30a8047b", "on": "2026-11-27", "build": "141/141" }`.
- `order_to_cash.provenance.json`: the same `scored` key (`174/174` at `30a8047b`); the build is untouched.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/verified-builds.test.ts`: per build, one more test. It scores the build against the namespaced card with this tree's scorer (`scoreCardArtifact` + `rollupSourceCharges`, the runner's `scoreInto`) and requires every measured Build check to pass with no roll-up charge, and the provenance's `scored` to name a runner sha, a date and an all-pass reading. A scorer change that refuses a committed build now fails in the PR that makes it, and the message says what to do.
- `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` (Verified builds): `scored` described, and what a scorer change that fails a verified build does (re-score in the same PR; amend when the platform moved under the build, else rebuild; move `scored`).

## Why

Which side is right: **the scorer**. The card asks for the lines "edited inline on the claim's form". The build was authored on 2026-11-18, when `inlineEdit` on a master-detail FK inlined the child in the master's form by itself. Since the maintainer's #35889 ruling (ADR-0035, amended 2026-11-20: 「主从子表我认为不应该自动申明放在概览中，除非我通过 fieldGroup 强制指定」) the form inlines a child only where a field group of the MASTER names it, and `inlineEdit` only picks the form factor (`attachInlineSubforms`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`). The build names no such group, so on today's runtime the claim's form does not edit its lines inline. #37135 moved the check to that same test (`scenario-tags.ts` `records-forms.master-detail-inline-edit`), so its "0 edited inline" is a true reading. No card expectation is in question, so no product call is needed.

Re-verify by amendment, not by a new build: Sales paused new eval rounds (11:36Z), and the gap is one key the platform's own ruling moved under the build. That is the same kind of hand edit as the two earlier `amended` entries (#36534, #37229), recorded the same way. `verified` stays the authoring run's reading (135/135 under that day's checks); `scored` is the latest re-score.

Small calls made in this thread (listed per the small-things rule): the key is named `scored` with `runner` (same 8-hex style as the top-level `runner`), not a per-file scorer hash; the test pins "all measured checks pass", not the exact count, so a scorer PR that only adds a passing check does not have to touch provenance; `order_to_cash` gets `scored` too so the test holds for every build.

## Verification

- Re-score at `30a8047b` (namespaced card, `scoreCardArtifact` + `rollupSourceCharges`):
  - travel_expense, before: Build 140/141, failing only `master-detail-inline-edit` ("0 edited inline"), 0 roll-up charges (matches the #34920 thread's reading).
  - travel_expense, after: Build 141/141, 0 charges.
  - order_to_cash: Build 174/174, 0 charges.
- `verified-builds.test.ts`: 13/13 pass. With the old build put back it fails 2 (sha256 pin, and the new re-score test with `reads Build 140/141 … master-detail-inline-edit (0 edited inline)`).
- `defineStack` on the build before and after reports the same 4 issues (duplicate action keys from the compiled artifact form, present on `main` too); the new field group adds none.
- `@objectstack/scenarios`: `tsc --noEmit` clean; vitest 1386 passed, 1 failed + 2 files failed, all pre-existing in this container: `test/build/*` need the package's own build, `packages.test.ts` pinned-pnpm fails on `main` here too.
- No eval round run.

Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
